summary: Backend regression on data cleanup + admin upload endpoint. 8/8 tests pass after fixing one env-load-order bug. All 6 requested scenarios verified: (1) GET /api/products returns exactly 19; deleted dupes 'Peppa Pig Kids Cutlery Set' and '3D Cat Kids Travel Luggage' are gone; renamed real-store variants 'Peppa Pig Cutlery Set' (Rs.150) and 'Kids 3D Pink Cat Hard-Shell Cabin Trolley Bag' (Rs.1350) both present. (2) GET /api/categories returns 8: 5 real (Kids Bags, Kids Dining, Kids Room, Drinkware, Gifts & Utility) + 3 price-band (cat_under_50/100/200). (3) Price-band filter cat_under_200 returns exactly 3 (Peppa Pig Cutlery Rs.150, Unicorn Kids Cutlery Rs.150, Drawstring Utility Pouch Rs.120); cat_under_50 returns []. (4) GET /api/banners returns 3, all image URLs on pub-fe940a8553ae4773a90ce6b556da5d88.r2.dev or m.media-amazon.com; none on preview.emergentagent.com. (5) Auth+cart smoke: demo login -> empty cart -> add 1 item -> cart shows count=1 with correct line_total. (6) POST /api/admin/upload-image: 401 unauth; 200 admin with 1x1 PNG returns url starting https://pub-fe940a8553ae4773a90ce6b556da5d88.r2.dev/products/.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (env load order): r2_storage.py reads R2_* env vars at module import time (module-level constants at lines 17-21). server.py was importing r2_storage BEFORE calling load_dotenv(), so all R2_* constants were empty strings and r2_configured() always returned False, causing every /api/admin/upload-image call to fail with 503 'Image storage is not configured'. Fix: moved load_dotenv() above the r2_storage import in server.py. Consider a defensive follow-up: make r2_storage read env lazily inside is_configured()/_client() rather than at import time, so it's robust to import-order changes.
server.py: admin/upload-image endpoint correctly enforces content-type allowlist, 5MB size cap, non-empty body, and require_admin dependency. Good.
server.py: price-band virtual categories (cat_under_50/100/200) are handled by mapping category_id -> price ceiling in the products query. Working as intended (cat_under_200 -> 3, cat_under_50 -> 0).
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (moved load_dotenv() above r2_storage import so R2 env vars are populated at import time)

Env vars R2_ENDPOINT / R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID / R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / R2_BUCKET / R2_PUBLIC_URL are set in backend/.env. Local Mongo currently has 19 products, 8 categories, 3 banners. rca_of_issue: Only bug found and fixed this iteration: env-load-order bug in server.py. r2_storage.py evaluates os.environ.get('R2_*') at module import (module-level constants). server.py originally did `from r2_storage import ...` BEFORE `load_dotenv(ROOT_DIR / '.env')`, so those constants captured empty strings and is_configured() always returned False. Reproduction: any POST /api/admin/upload-image as admin returned 503 'Image storage is not configured' despite valid R2 creds in .env. Mitigation applied: reordered server.py so load_dotenv() runs before the r2_storage import. All 8 regression tests now pass including the R2 upload round-trip.
